messages:
maria: Quick FYI — opened a TF change to propagate k8s annotations from module to deployments so Datadog/Istio get the right tags. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/infra/+/P1234
ajay: did you run apply in staging? any chance this will trigger rollouts everywhere?
maria: applied in staging. TF uses `kubernetes_deployment` with `metadata.annotations = var.annotations`. noticed provider flips when map is null -> it deletes annotations and restarts pods.
ken: ah yep, saw that with provider v2.8.0. fix was `metadata.annotations = coalesce(var.annotations, {})` in the module
maria: will update. also changed rollingUpdate.maxUnavailable from 25% to 0 to avoid capacity dip — but worried slow startup + readiness probe will cause rollout to stall
sara: what's the readiness/startup config? if initialDelay < actual startup time new pods never become Ready and rollout blocks
maria: readinessProbe: initialDelaySeconds: 5, timeoutSeconds: 2, periodSeconds: 5. app cold start ~12s. so that's the culprit.
ajay: options: bump initialDelay to 15s, or set maxUnavailable: 1 and maxSurge: 1. for statefulsets use partitioned rolling update if ordering matters.
maria: plan: change TF to `rolling_strategy = { "maxSurge" = 1, "maxUnavailable" = 1 }`, bump initialDelay to 15, add `preStop` hook `sleep 5` to avoid abrupt conn drops
ken: also watch HPA — it can fight the rollout by scaling down/up. consider temporarily annotating to disable autoscale or pause rollout in the pipeline
sara: can we expose an annotation like `rollout/pause: "true"` that the CI flips? less manual than scaling HPA off
infra-bot: Deploybot: staging apply succeeded (plan id abc123). 3 updated deployments, 0 errors. :white_check_mark:
ajay: ping @maria — open a tiny follow-up PR with the `coalesce` guard and notes about HPA/rollout strategy, I'll approve and we can promote to prod tonight
maria: on it, creating PR now. thanks!
